item.title: Warsaw Alumnus Kicks Rams to NFC Championship Game
item.description: The Los Angeles Rams needed overtime to defeat the host Chicago Bears Sunday, Jan. 18, 20-17. The Rams were also in need of Warsaw Community High School alumnus Harrison Mevis to hit the game-winning field goal and Mevis came through from 42 yards.

item.title: Committee Passes Capital Case Protections, Senate Holds Firing Squad Bill
item.description: An Indiana House committee unanimously advanced a bill Wednesday tightening protections for defendants with intellectual disabilities in capital cases, while a Senate proposal allowing firing squad executions remains on hold as lawmakers approach key legislative deadlines.

item.title: Fort Wayne Awarded $50 Million In New Markets Tax Credits
item.description: Fort Wayne will receive $50 million in New Markets Tax Credits allocation authority from the U.S. Treasury Department to promote economic growth.

item.title: Indiana University Wins First Ever National Championship In Football
item.description: Indiana University defeated the University of Miami 27-21 Monday, Jan. 19, to win its first ever national championship in college football.
